resources.string: Use funds you can spend before deductions. Enter zero explicitly when you have no planned savings or additional unpaid bills.

Available funds are your own estimate. Enter only savings and older or untracked bills that are still to be deducted. Paid markers are not bank confirmation. This guide includes current overdue bills and bills due through the next income date. It counts today and excludes income day. The daily amount rounds down to cents. The estimated income date is not guaranteed.

Enter the monthly savings baseline first. The signed adjustment excludes any category cuts below. The first hypothetical contribution is at the end of next month. This estimate does not save anything or guarantee a date.
Confirm LKR %1$s in tracked unpaid bills. Include any older or untracked unpaid bills separately.
Use a valid date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
Enter a valid LKR amount with up to two decimal places.
Use a positive reduction and select each category only once.
Create a savings goal to run a simulation.
Estimated income date from the last recorded income: %1$s
Enter a next income date; no recorded income date is available.
Income is due today. A daily allowance is unavailable.
The estimated or entered date has passed. Enter a future date.
Tracked bills changed. Check and confirm the new amount.
No monthly savings remain under these inputs.
The estimate exceeds the simulation horizon.
